name: T. Greene
bio: T. Greene, usually printed as 'Supt. Green', was the Northern Pacific's superintendent of the Missouri division and came through Medora often on railroad business. In August 1884 he oversaw repairs from the Hotel de Mores, though the paper noted local anger at him. In fall 1885 he chose the site for and oversaw the building of new stock yards at Medora. In October 1886 he ran for the territorial legislature on the Democratic ticket, and the paper disputed a Bismarck report that he had toured the road in his private car telling railroad men to vote for him, saying he had told men at Medora to vote as they thought best.
